tools_problematic.problem: The installed winapp CLI has no build subcommand.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turn 8: 'build' was not matched and exited 1.

tool_limitations.limitation: It copied only the selected source subtree, so XAML-referenced images supplied through the repository's sibling SharedContent tree were absent.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Inventory unresolved ms-appx asset references and report them explicitly, including likely linked/shared source locations.

tool_limitations.limitation: It initially ignored the default bin\Debug output and, for 0xc000027b with no event 1026, returned only a broad legacy-projection hint.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Standardize the documented build on -p:Platform=x64 and enrich native-stowed-exception diagnostics when no managed event exists.

failed_apis.why_tried: The bootstrap classified all four occurrences as migrate-as-is, so the legacy directive remained in page and control-template XAML.
failed_apis.root_cause: The migration inventory and patterns had no rule for the superseded XAML directive; the app then failed during native XAML startup with 0xc000027b.
failed_apis.fix: Mechanically rewrite the exact legacy value to x:Load="False" and reject residue. This equivalent was not attempted in the trial.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and final build instructions
doc_errors.correct: Use native dotnet build with -p:Platform=x64; reserve winapp for packaged launch.

doc_errors.wrong: The bootstrap emitted '| (none) |' while the validator recognized only 'No items deferred'.
doc_errors.correct: The producer and validator must use the same no-items sentinel.

special_apis.special_handling: Replace Lazy with x:Load=False while preserving x:Name and realization through FindName, GetTemplateChild, VisualState targeting, or binding; Window-root realization requires x:Bind rather than FindName.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold, bootstrap, and Test-Path commands were launched concurrently despite their dependency order.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent reran bootstrap after dotnet new completed.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill prescribed a subcommand absent from the installed CLI.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent switched to dotnet build.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent temporarily split related partial classes and converter types across inconsistent SDKTemplate and XamlDeferLoadStrategy namespaces.
errors_encountered.fix: It reconciled x:Class, code-behind, converter, and shell references to a consistent namespace.

errors_encountered.error: CS9035 required members in generated XamlTypeInfo.g.cs
errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent added required properties to XAML-activatable model types; generated activation uses parameterless construction.
errors_encountered.fix: It replaced required members with initialized properties.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch status=unavailable: no build output under bin\x64\Debug
errors_encountered.root_cause: The first dotnet build used the default output path rather than the helper's x64 convention.

errors_encountered.error: CS2001 missing generated *.g.i.cs and WMC0001 during turn 42
errors_encountered.root_cause: Build, launch, and validation commands that mutate/read the same obj/bin trees were run concurrently.
errors_encountered.fix: A later clean sequential rebuild restored a clean build.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Unresolved native XAML startup failure; the trial left the superseded deferral directive in four XAML locations and the crash tooling captured no managed stack.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Bootstrap and self-check ran before scaffolding completed and had to be repeated.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Following the already numbered Step 0 commands sequentially.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Multiple namespace and generated-code build failures followed agent-authored namespace and required-member changes.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Partial-class namespace reconciliation was done piecemeal, and required members were incompatible with XAML activation.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Unified namespaces and used initialized properties.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A pre-build invariant that x:Class, code-behind namespace, related partial classes, and XAML-activatable types remain constructible.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent merged resources and removed title-bar/backdrop features, but the same 0xc000027b crash persisted.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The skill had no x:DeferLoadStrategy migration rule and the crash helper had no managed stack for the native stowed exception.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Unresolved; the agent correctly reported the blocker.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A bootstrap rewrite and validator residue rule for the superseded XAML deferral directive.

missing_tooling.need: A deterministic rewrite/check for superseded XAML language directives.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The unresolved startup-debugging loop and the final candidate launch failure.
